5 AI coding habits to stop right now (and what to do instead)

Five AI coding habits to drop right now.

1. Giant prompts - Smaller steps beat one giant prompt.
2. Accepting unread diffs - Read what the AI changed.
3. Skipping tests - Ask for tests with every change.
4. Retyping your rules - Put them in steering files once.
5. Coding without a plan - Write the spec before the code.

Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/specs/best-practices/
